transcript:
Speaker A (Voiceover): तीन इंग्लिश वर्ड्स - Want, Need, Have. आम सी लगती हैं, लेकिन एक डॉन की बेटी और एक अंडरकवर टीचर के बीच ये तीन वर्ड्स का मतलब प्यार भी बन गया और चोट भी। [Three English words - Want, Need, Have. They seem common, but between a don't daughter and an undercover teacher, these three words meant love and also pain.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): अरे वाह! आज सूरज कहाँ से उग गया? तुम यहाँ मुझसे पहले आ गयी। [Oh wow! Where did the sun rise from today? You came here before me.]
Speaker C (Ayesha): मेरा मन हुआ तो आ गयी। [I felt like it, so I came.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): गुड। तो आज हम कुछ नया सीखेंगे। [Good. So today we will learn something new.]
Speaker D (Voiceover): शेखर अब बोर्ड पर लिखो। [Shekhar, now write on the board.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): ये दुनिया तीन वर्ड्स पे चलती है। पहला है... [This world runs on three words. First is...]
Speaker D (Voiceover): Want.
Speaker B (Shekhar): Want. हमें जो चाहिए। [Want. What we want.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): दूसरा... [Second...]
Speaker D (Voiceover): Need.
Speaker B (Shekhar): Need. जिसकी हमें ज़रूरत है। [Need. What we need.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): और तीसरा... [And third...]
Speaker D (Voiceover): Have.
Speaker B (Shekhar): Have. वो जो हमारे पास पहले से है। [Have. What we already have.]
Speaker B (Shekhar): एग्जांपल के तौर पे... You have a smartphone. You need a copy. I want... [For example... You have a smartphone. You need a copy. I want...]
Speaker C (Ayesha): तुम कल रात मेरे कमरे में आये थे। अपनी जान खतरे में डाल के तुम मुझे बचाने क्यों आये थे? तुम्हारी want और need क्या है? [You came to my room last night. Putting your life in danger, why did you come to save me? What is your want and need?]
Speaker A (Voiceover): क्या है शेखर की want और need? जवाब जानने के लिए खोलो English Seekho ऐप और सर्च करो 'Jasoos Teacher'। ये बस ड्रामा नहीं है, सीखने का मौका है। जो इंग्लिश इस मिशन की जान थी, वो आप भी सीखो उसी ऐप पर। तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [What is Shekhar's want and need? To know the answer, open the English Seekho app and search 'Jasoos Teacher'. This is not just drama, it's an opportunity to learn. The English that was the life of this mission, you learn it too on the same app. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text:
JASOOS TEACHER
English Seekho
Mere dil mein toh pyar hai. Tumhare dil mein kya hai, Ayesha? Bolo. [There is love in my heart. What is in your heart, Ayesha? Speak.]

Toh aaj hum kuchh naya sikhenge. [So today we will learn something new.]
Shekhar, ab board par likho. [Shekhar, now write on the board.]
Want.
Need.
Jiski hamein zaroorat hai. [What we need.]
Have.
Woh jo hamare paas pehle se hai. [What we already have.]
Example ke taur pe... [For example...]
You have a smartphone.
You need a copy.
I want...
Tum kal raat mere kamre mein aaye the. [You came to my room last night.]
Apni jaan khatre mein daal ke tum mujhe bachane kyun aaye the? [Putting your life in danger, why did you come to save me?]
Tumhari want aur need kya hai? [What is your want and need?]
jasoos teacher

summary: The ad features a dramatic skit from a series called 'Jasoos Teacher' where an undercover teacher explains the difference between 'want', 'need', and 'have' to a student. The student confronts him about saving her life, asking what his true intentions are. The voiceover prompts viewers to download the English Seekho app to watch the rest of the drama and learn English.
